en.headline: Observatory issues yellow fire danger warning as risk stays high
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the yellow fire danger warning at 9:45am on Sunday, urging the public to take precautions and hikers to stay vigilant.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a yellow fire danger warning at 9:45am on Sunday, stating that the fire risk is high.
The Observatory said the warning remains in force until further notice and reminded people to prevent fires from breaking out. Hikers were advised to be particularly careful.
No other weather warnings were in force. The Observatory forecast mainly cloudy conditions on Sunday with sunny intervals during the day and a maximum temperature around 29 degrees.

zh.headline: 天文台發出黃色火災危險警告 火警風險高
zh.dek: 天文台周日上午9時45分發出黃色火災危險警告，提醒市民小心防火，郊遊人士提高警覺。
body: 香港天文台周日上午9時45分發出黃色火災危險警告，表示火災危險性頗高。
天文台表示警告將持續生效，直至另行通知，並呼籲市民防止火警發生，郊遊人士應特別小心。
目前並無其他天氣警告生效。天文台預測周日大致多雲，日間部分時間有陽光，最高氣溫約29度。
